agents.note: US-456 CLOSED (passes:true) -- static_data disposition (D-5/F-082, size S, CIO-decided). DECISION: KEEP the table honest-empty (NOT drop); no TD-061. 3 targeted tests GREEN + ruff clean on both touched .py files. GROUNDING: static_data holds one-time OBD params keyed on a NOT NULL `vin` FK -> vehicle_info(vin); VIN reads over OBD Mode 09; the current ECU MD326328 is Mode-09-SILENT (tuner knowledge) -> VIN un-gettable -> no valid FK -> no honest row can exist. The collector ALREADY handles this honestly: collectStaticData() (static_collector.py:220-230) queries the VIN FIRST and on a null response raises VinNotAvailableError + writes ZERO rows -- never fabricates a placeholder VIN or synthetic vehicle_info record (_queryVin None on is_null :336-338; shouldCollect False on no-VIN :147-149). WHY KEEP over DROP: the empty table is already an honest instrument (honest-availability discipline); dropping cascades through a whole Pi subsystem (StaticDataCollector + vehicle/ package + ~15 exports + pi.staticData.* config + FK_static_data_vehicle + schema registration) -- grossly out of proportion to a size-S disposition with zero data-integrity benefit; and it re-activates automatically the moment a Mode-09-capable ECU is connected (hardware-conditional, not dead). DELIVERABLES: (a) tests/pi/obdii/test_static_data_honest_empty.py -- 3 real-DB guards (temp SQLite + real INSERT path per I-040; only the OBD connection faked as Mode-09-silent since no real silent ECU on dev bench): 0 rows written to static_data AND vehicle_info on null VIN + success=False/vin=None/errorMessage~VIN; shouldCollect declines; table still EXISTS post-disposition. Makes 'honest-empty' a VERIFIED invariant (a future placeholder-VIN fabrication fails the guard), not just prose. (b) database_schema.py disposition doc-comment above SCHEMA_STATIC_DATA (table SSOT). (c) docs/static-data-disposition.md durable drop-vs-keep record. NO config.json / no migration / no subsystem change. NOT a Refusal-Rule-1 blocker: PM scoped a bounded 2-option 'Decide + document' choice and the CIO already provided the decisive grounding fact (VIN un-gettable). mypy (strict) NOT in-loop (not in dev env) -> PM integration gate. Single-agent. Remaining AVAILABLE: US-457 (sprint-ready, docs-only, no deps). US-449/450/451/452 still BLOCKED (BL-017 root: live /analyze drive_statistics dual-writer, awaits Atlas ruling). -> NO tag (ralph.sh continues to next available, US-457).
